name: Farr
storyline:
In the age of legends, when kings ruled by divine glory known as Farr, the land of Iran stands on the edge of darkness. Zahhak, the serpent-shouldered tyrant, the demons of Mazandaran, and the armies of Turan rise to claim the world.

Step into the epic of Ferdowsi's Shahnameh, the 1,000-year-old Persian Book of Kings, and command its greatest heroes: Rostam the unbeatable champion, the young warrior Sohrab, the invincible Esfandiyar, and the wise Simorgh. Build your deck, master each hero's legendary power, and face rival players in strategic card battles.

Every card tells a story. Every battle is a page of the Shahnameh. Will your Farr be strong enough to defend the land of heroes?
